title: Financial Planning For The Big Exit: IPO, M&A, Or Tender Offer
description: This lively webinar features two seasoned financial planners explaining actionable strategies and tips for equity comp planning from startup to a big liquidity event: IPO, acquisition, or tender offer. Advising clients on billions of dollars of public and private company stock, these advisors guide employees, executives, and founders through every company growth stage and with all types of equity comp. With the IPO market making a comeback in 2025, learn practical ways to get your clients, with advisor guidance, to feel comfortable in making informed decisions to build their wealth and prevent mistakes following a potentially life-altering liquidity event.
learningObjectives: Strategies and pitfalls pre- and post-liquidity
Potential landmines in tender-offer participation, IPO lockups, M&A scenarios, QSBS stock
Common technical errors: mispriced 409(A) valuations, misclassified NQSOs vs. ISOs, double-trigger-vesting mishaps
Handling the emotional aftermath of liquidity events, including sudden-wealth syndrome
Client case studies involving the creation of financial independence
